San Francisco and Hentges Agree on Extension
Fans hailed the signing of <Sam Hentges:player#1229> today as the <San Francisco Giants:team#25> closer came to terms with the club.

Set to make $19,500,000 over the upcoming 2 years, <Hentges:player#1229> signed primarily out of loyalty to the organization, thrilling the most diehard supporters who think there isn't much loyalty in a market driven by free agency.

This year, <Hentges:player#1229> has earned 36 saves, made 62 relief appearances, fanned 64 hitters in 63 innings and posted an ERA of 2.29 and a 5-5 record.
